scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.test:e2e:planning-flow: playwright test e2e/import-entrypoints.spec.ts e2e/planning-draft-flow.spec.ts e2e/planning-inputs.spec.ts e2e/planner-route-adjustments.spec.ts e2e/planning-overlap-explanation.spec.ts e2e/guided-planning-workflow.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:dispatch:legacy: playwright test e2e/dispatch-resize.spec.ts e2e/dispatch-assignment.spec.ts e2e/dispatch-driver-selection.spec.ts e2e/dispatch-view-modes.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:dispatch: sleep 1 && flock /tmp/traivo-api-codegen-e2e.lock sh -c 'pnpm run test:e2e:planning-flow && pnpm run test:e2e:dispatch:legacy'
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
